**Do now:** Have billing/vendor support clear the overdue invoice and remove the 402 hold for `lw-prod` / `INV-20931`. The telemetry gives no invoice amount or payment procedure, so neither can be specified. Verify that `vela-origin` stops returning 402s, then confirm playback errors and fallback load subside.
